canDoYue: 你能夠講唔見咗咩、去邊度報失，同埋幾時要叫緊急幫手。
canDoEn: Say what you have lost, where to report it, and when to ask for emergency help.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I have lost my wallet, and I last saw it at the desk this morning.
dialogue.glossYue: 我唔見咗個銀包，今朝最後一次見係喺櫃檯。
dialogue.say: I have lost my wallet, and I last saw it at the desk this morning.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you help me report it now, because my passport was inside the wallet?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以而家幫我報失？因為護照喺銀包入面。
dialogue.say: Could you help me report it now, because my passport was inside the wallet?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: The police desk is nearby, and they can write the missing item report for you.
dialogue.glossYue: 警崗喺附近，佢哋可以幫你寫搵唔到物件嘅報告。
dialogue.say: The police desk is nearby, and they can write the missing item report for you.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I think the wallet was stolen, so I also need the embassy number.
dialogue.glossYue: 我諗個銀包畀人偷咗，所以我亦都要大使館電話。
dialogue.say: I think the wallet was stolen, so I also need the embassy number.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: The embassy number is on this card, and I will help you file the report.
dialogue.glossYue: 大使館電話喺呢張卡上面，我會幫你報失。
dialogue.say: The embassy number is on this card, and I will help you file the report.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: The wallet is still missing, but your passport copies are in the safe.
dialogue.glossYue: 銀包仲搵唔到，不過護照副本喺夾萬。
dialogue.say: The wallet is still missing, but your passport copies are in the safe.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I feel faint after the shock, so please tell me if this is an emergency.
dialogue.glossYue: 我受驚之後覺得暈，唔該話我知係咪緊急。
dialogue.say: I feel faint after the shock, so please tell me if this is an emergency.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: If you feel faint, I can call an ambulance while we file the report.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果你覺得暈，我可以叫救護車，同時我哋報失。
dialogue.say: If you feel faint, I can call an ambulance while we file the report.

sound.note: wallet 有 /l/。舌尖抵住上顎後面。police 重音喺第二節。embassy 重音喺第一節。
